import sys

class AK375:
    def compute(self, length, s):
        tempStr2 = []
        tempStr1 = []
        maxLen = 0
        count = 0

        i = 0
        while i < length:
            c = s[i]
            if c == '(':
                tempStr2.append('_')
                j = i + 1
                while j < length and s[j] != ')':
                    tempStr2.append(s[j])
                    j += 1
                i = j
            elif c == ')':
                tempStr1.append('_')
            else:
                tempStr1.append(c)
            i += 1

        parts2 = ''.join(tempStr2).split('_')
        list2 = [part for part in parts2 if part]
        count = len(list2)

        parts1 = ''.join(tempStr1).split('_')
        for p in parts1:
            if len(p) > maxLen:
                maxLen = len(p)

        return f"{maxLen} {count}"

def main():
    input_lines = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    while index < len(input_lines):
        n = int(input_lines[index])
        index += 1
        s = input_lines[index]
        index += 1
        result = AK375().compute(n, s)
        print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
